data.one_liner: Collection of more than 250 vector-based world flags rendered as widgets without assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 250 vector-based country, language, and currency flags implemented as CustomPainters. Flags adapt to any size and shape while maintaining true proportions without using image, SVG, or font assets. Includes support for custom styling and shaders.
use_when: You need to display world country flags without bundling heavy image or SVG assets.
You need flags to dynamically adapt their size, shape, or aspect ratio in the UI.
avoid_when: You require traditional raster or asset-based flag graphics rather than code-driven CustomPainters.
strengths: Zero assets used, keeping app bundle size lightweight.
Fully customizable shapes, aspect ratios, and styles via Flutter widgets and custom painters.
Includes more than 250 declarative world flags following official color standards.
weaknesses: Limited to the provided collection of world, language, and currency flags.
data.setup_notes: Add world_flags as a dependency in your pubspec.yaml file.
